title: FILTER evaluates its predicate in the row context of each row

source.quote: FILTER can filter rows from a table by using any expression valid in the row context.
source.supports: FILTER keeps the rows for which the expression, evaluated in the row context, is true

derivation: Prices: Bike 100, Helmet 20, Lock 10, Scooter 50. Only Lock (10) fails Price > 15.
